title: Todd Monken: "'Browns are gonna Browns' — f—k that"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken: "'Browns are gonna Browns' — f—k that"
sources.description: When NBC analyst Mike Tomlin quoted JuJu Smith-Schuster and said, “Browns is the Browns” after the team’s embarrassing 34-10 loss to open the season, Cleveland head coach Todd Monken said he didn’t see it that way.
